interpretation.runtimeEngineering: failed practical throughput for this development batch

cause: The public gtsam 4.2 wheel lacks IncrementalFixedLagSmoother. The correctness backend rebuilds a bounded ISAM2 graph and computes per-dimension marginal covariance on every estimator update, making the 32-episode MuJoCo batch impractically slow.
stopDecision: Stopped to avoid unbounded pay-as-you-go cost. This is not classified as a behavioral failure.
nextGate: Replace the batch-rebuild path with a genuinely incremental fixed-lag implementation or an equivalent bounded-state backend, add an explicit estimator wall-clock throughput gate, then rerun the unchanged frozen severe design.
claimBoundary: No behavioral conclusion is drawn from an interrupted batch. The valid new evidence is limited to protocol correctness already established and insufficient practical throughput of this engineering implementation.
